Games/Star Drift

Arcade

Star Drift.

Steer a small ship through falling debris and survive as long as you can.

How to play

  • Steer with ← → or A D.
  • Hold Space to brake against the drift.
  • Press P to pause, M to mute, R to restart.
  • Motion follows your system reduce-motion setting.

Play Star Drift

  • Score 0
  • Lives 3
  • Time 0:00

Press Restart or focus the playfield to start.

Devlog

The first ship taught us restraint. A canvas, a scoreboard, and three buttons turned out to be enough for a real game, so nothing else was added. The debris falls a little faster the longer you survive, which keeps each run under a few minutes. Sound is synthesized in the browser and stays quiet until you ask for it.
